question: Will U.S. continued unemployment insurance claims (DOL, seasonally adjusted, week ending) for the latest weekly reading dated on or before 2026-01-13 (expected: 2026-01-10) be above 1,929,000, its value for the week dated 2025-09-27?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2025-10-15 (the week dated 2025-09-27), rounded as shown
